name: ai-powered-call-router
description: AI-powered inbound call router on Telnyx Edge Compute + Agent SDK — answers an inbound call, gathers the caller's spoken request, classifies intent via the zero-credential Telnyx AI Inference binding, looks up the transfer destination in Telnyx KV, and blind-bridges the call. Stateful per-call lifecycle via a StatefulActor; route table in global KV.
